concept.title: Perfect Numbers: Structure of Even Perfects
concept.concept_description: Formalize the Euclid-Euler theorem: n is an even perfect number iff n = 2^(p-1)(2^p - 1) where 2^p - 1 is prime. Prove that odd perfect numbers, if they exist, must have at least 101 prime factors (Nielsen's bound). Formalize the abundancy index σ(n)/n framework.

concept.title: Ramsey Theory: Bounds and Constructions
concept.concept_description: Formalize Ramsey's theorem and prove tight bounds: R(3,3)=6, R(3,4)=9, R(4,4)=18. Prove the Erdős-Szekeres bound R(s,t) ≤ C(s+t-2, s-1). Construct the best known lower bound via the probabilistic method. Formalize the Hales-Jewett theorem.
